scope.summary: Multiple MCP clients share one oraclemcp by default with no flags: stdio auto-attaches to a per-state-root broker (0600 socket) that owns the service lock, single audit writer and pools; HTTP is stateful by default with caps and coexists with stdio on one root; sessions are isolated; credentials are bound per client with a keyed digest; dead launchers are reclaimed immediately.
out_of_scope: Broker inherits the HTTP launcher's stderr and can wedge if that pipe is not drained (new bug filed).

Changed by these commits but excluded from the clean-scope binding because later landings modified them: crates/oraclemcp-config/src/config_docs.rs, crates/oraclemcp/src/main.rs, docs/configuration.md, oraclemcp.example.toml

entry_points.name: verification #1 (c0fab7e2): 3 concurrent stdio clients, isolation, single audit writer, idle exit, version mismatch, TRANSIENT on kill, socket 0600, HTTP stateful+caps
verification #2 (d5338f84): HTTP/stdio coexistence both orders, 1 HTTP + 2 stdio isolation, wrong/missing password refused
verification #3 (d30fe11f): D1 replacement after SIGKILL ready 0.04 s, D2 wrong first client does not pin broker, D3 HMAC-SHA256 per-broker nonce, 5 stdio + HTTP coexistence, audit verify ok

limitations: XE21/XE18 not exercised for the broker (transport-level feature); Windows/macOS covered by CI broker IPC jobs.
Live artifact is a summary of the verifier's logs.
